_comment: Optional, for sharing Library documents with `node app/publish.js`. publishDir: a local folder synced to OneDrive/Dropbox/Drive that receives copies. shareBase: that folder's web address, so the hub can build per-file links. Leave both empty if you do not publish.
_comment_repos: Repos page: git checkouts next to the vault. roots: folders to look in (each child folder with a .git folder is a repo; the standard macOS folders are skipped). exclude: folder names to leave out, e.g. a private vault. about: a one-line description per folder name, used instead of the README.
